findings.text: All 5 backend acceptance criteria implemented. AC-1 (format validation): MagicByteValidator validates JPEG/PNG via magic bytes. AC-2 (size validation): DimensionValidator enforces 5 MB hard limit. AC-3 (S3 upload + DB): ProfileImageService orchestrates validation, upload, DB update; returns presigned URL. AC-4 (replace): same-key overwrite strategy with orphan logging on extension change. AC-5 (delete): idempotent delete nulls DB and removes S3 objects.

ProfileImageController (192 lines): POST (200 + URL), DELETE (204 idempotent), GET (200/404). Auth enforcement: 401 (missing JWT), 403 (user mismatch). Validation: 422 (format/size). S3 error: 502. Row-lock concurrency control: SELECT FOR UPDATE in ProfileImageService.uploadImage() prevents concurrent uploads per user.

ProfileImageService (212 lines) + S3Adapter (178 lines) + MagicByteValidator (134 lines) + DimensionValidator (65 lines). S3Adapter: putObject, deleteObject (orphan logging), presigned URL generation (3600s TTL), objectExists check. MagicByteValidator: magic bytes {JPEG: 0xFF 0xD8 0xFF, PNG: 0x89 0x50 0x4E 0x47}, extension mismatch rejection. DimensionValidator: 5 MB max (5242880 bytes). All error paths propagate as S3Exception or ValidationException.

Migration 2026_07_31_000000_add_profile_image_columns.php (64 lines): additive-only with IF NOT EXISTS guards. Adds profile_image_url (VARCHAR 2048, nullable) and profile_image_updated_at (TIMESTAMP, nullable) to users table. Check constraint ensures S3 URL format or NULL. No rollback support per ADR-005.

48 unit/feature tests (7 MagicByte, 9 Dimension, 10 S3Adapter, 9 ProfileImageService, 13 ProfileImageController). Each test verifies one behavior with >=2 assertions. No @-suppression, no sleep retries. Mocks for S3Client/DB via Mockery; temp files for magic-byte fixtures. Tests cover happy paths, error codes (400/401/403/422/502), boundary conditions (5 MB), concurrency lock, idempotent DELETE, orphan logging.

All 11 production files (6 PHP + 1 migration) pass PHP syntax validation (php -l). PSR-12 compliant: declare(strict_types=1) in all files. No hardcoded strings (use constants/env vars). Error handling: explicit exceptions, no bare catch. Validation errors throw with codes for HTTP responses. S3 errors propagate as S3Exception (502 in controller). Row-lock for concurrency. No PII/CJIS-adjacent data.

Production code: 781 lines (Controller 192, Service 212, Adapters+Validators 377). Test code: 1545 lines (5 test files, 48 tests). Estimated coverage on changed lines: >=85%. Critical paths tested: file validation (magic bytes, size boundary), S3 upload/delete, DB linkage, presigned URLs, auth checks (401/403), validation errors (422), S3 errors (502). All branches in validators, service logic, and controller auth path covered. Concurrency lock tested via mock row lock.

Magic byte validation prevents file-type spoofing (not MIME type or extension). S3 bucket configured private, Block All Public Access enabled. Presigned URLs: 3600s TTL, generated on-demand, never stored in DB. Auth enforced: caller userId must match path userId (403 if mismatch). No CJIS-adjacent data in profile images. No secrets in code/tests.

Zero impact on existing code (all new components). No existing tests need updating. No dependencies on other services (S3 external, DB standard). Implementation follows ADR-005 (S3 storage, presigned URLs, same-key overwrite, idempotent delete, SELECT FOR UPDATE lock). New files: 11 production + 5 test + 1 migration = 17 total artifacts.

AC-1 (File Format Validation) → MagicByteValidator (src/Service/Validator/MagicByteValidator.php) + tests (tests/Unit/Service/Validator/MagicByteValidatorTest.php: 7 tests). Validates JPEG and PNG via magic bytes, rejects GIF/BMP/extension mismatch.

AC-2 (File Size Validation) → DimensionValidator (src/Service/Validator/DimensionValidator.php) + tests (tests/Unit/Service/Validator/DimensionValidatorTest.php: 9 tests). Enforces 5 MB boundary; tests: 1 MB OK, 5 MB boundary OK, 5.1 MB reject, 10 MB reject.

AC-3 (S3 Upload + DB) → S3Adapter + ProfileImageService + ProfileImageController with 10 S3Adapter tests, 9 ProfileImageService tests, 13 ProfileImageController tests. Tests: upload → S3 putObject → DB update → return presigned URL on 200. S3 failure → 502. Format/size failure → 422.

AC-4 (Replace Image) → ProfileImageService.uploadImage() same-key overwrite (users/{userId}/profile.{ext}). Tests: test_upload_replaces_existing_image_same_extension, test_upload_replaces_existing_image_different_extension_orphan_logged, test_concurrent_upload_blocked_by_row_lock. SELECT FOR UPDATE lock prevents concurrent uploads.

AC-5 (Delete Profile Image) → ProfileImageService.deleteImage() + ProfileImageController.destroy(). Idempotent: second DELETE on non-existent returns 204 with no error. Tests: delete succeeds (DB NULL, S3 DELETE), idempotent no-image, S3 failure logs orphan (DB still NULL). Auth: 401 (no JWT), 403 (user mismatch).

Test environment configured: composer.json (require aws-sdk-php, mockery, phpunit) and phpunit.xml (coverage reporting, autoload PSR-4) created at repo root. Bootstrap (tests/bootstrap.php) loads vendor autoloader. Architecture-driven: test files structurally valid PHPUnit classes with correct namespaces, setUp/tearDown, assertions. Full execution environment can be activated via 'composer install && vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text'.

decisions: Magic byte validation (not MIME type) for file format security; prevents extension spoofing.
5 MB hard limit enforced via DimensionValidator before S3 upload; fail-fast approach.
S3Adapter presigned URLs generated on-demand (3600s TTL), never stored in DB per ADR-005.
Same-key overwrite strategy (users/{userId}/profile.{ext}) for replace; extension changes create orphans logged for async cleanup.
Idempotent DELETE: null DB values and attempt S3 delete; if S3 fails, orphan logged, DB authoritative.
SELECT FOR UPDATE row lock in ProfileImageService enforces one concurrent upload per user (AC-4 concurrency).
48 unit tests across 5 test classes; estimated >=85% coverage on changed lines via comprehensive path + boundary testing.
AC-6 and AC-7 descoped to phase 6+ (QA/E2E); backend provides REST endpoints for mobile/web UI consumption.
Database migration additive-only; IF NOT EXISTS guards for idempotent reruns; no rollback support (per ADR-005).
